seo.title: Al Jazibiah Beauty Salon | Ladies Salon in Al Nahda, Sharjah
seo.description: Ladies' salon in Al Nahda, Sharjah for over 20 years: keratin & protein Botox from AED 299, gel nails from AED 49, Moroccan bath, threading and facials. 4.7 from 801 Google reviews.

hero.lede: A women-owned ladies' salon for keratin and hair Botox, colour, gel nails, Moroccan bath and threading. Some clients have been coming for almost 18 years.
